tui.projects_edit.form_title.note: Detail-page edit form identity; appended after the bold 'projects', same shape as tui.projects.new_project. Keep the leading middot and space.

tui.projects_edit.binding_edit.note: Binding for `e` on the project detail page; opens the prefilled edit form. Not painted in the hint row (hints use the shorter hint_ keys).

tui.projects_edit.binding_add_milestone.note: Binding for `a` on the detail page; opens the add-milestone prompt.

tui.projects_edit.binding_remove_milesto.note: Binding for `x` on the detail page; asks the inline y/n confirm before removing the selected milestone.

tui.projects_edit.binding_next_field.note: Tab inside the add-milestone prompt; moves between its two fields.

tui.projects_edit.binding_add.note: Enter inside the add-milestone prompt; submits it.

tui.projects_edit.binding_cancel.note: Escape inside the add-milestone prompt; closes it without writing.

tui.projects_edit.hint_edit.note: Detail footer hint after the `e` key. Lowercase; the painter supplies the leading space and the key glyph.

tui.projects_edit.hint_add_milestone.note: Detail footer hint after the `a` key. Lowercase.

tui.projects_edit.hint_remove_milestone.note: Detail footer hint after the `x` key; armed only while a milestone row is selected. Lowercase.

tui.projects_edit.hint_next_field.note: Add-milestone prompt footer hint after `tab`. Lowercase.

tui.projects_edit.hint_add.note: Add-milestone prompt footer hint after `enter`. Lowercase.

tui.projects_edit.hint_cancel.note: Escape label in the add-milestone prompt footer. Lowercase.

tui.projects_edit.key_hint_edit.note: Under the key field in EDIT mode only. Create mode keeps tui.projects' follows-the-title hint. Single line; may clip at narrow widths.

tui.projects_edit.refusal_estimate_clear.note: Under the estimate field when the reader clears it: the store has no clear state for an estimate (ProjectEdit.estimate None means untouched). Must name the two ways forward.

tui.projects_edit.refusal_estimate_numbe.note: Under the estimate field when the text is not a number; matches the store's own sentence for the same case.

tui.projects_edit.refusal_estimate_range.note: Under the estimate field when the number is outside the store's bound. {maximum} is the cap the store enforces (1000).

tui.projects_edit.refusal_date_order.note: Under the target date when it precedes the start date. Mirrors the create form's rule in this namespace so the edit form does not reach into a pinned namespace.

tui.projects_edit.refusal_name_required.note: Under the key field when it is emptied. Same meaning as the create form's sentence; the edit form has no auto-slug, so there is no example to give.

tui.projects_edit.refusal_project_gone_e.note: Footer notice when the project vanished between opening the edit form and saving. {name} is the project's display name.

tui.projects_edit.refusal_project_gone_m.note: Footer notice when the project vanished during an add/remove milestone write. {name} is the project's display name.

tui.projects_edit.no_changes.note: Form footer after ctrl+s with nothing changed: no write happened. Short — the footer is one row.

tui.projects_edit.saved.note: Detail footer after an edit landed. Short; the page recomposes from the store around it.

tui.projects_edit.confirm_remove.note: Pinned one-line question before removing a milestone. Keep `y` and `n` literal: they are the keys. {name} is the milestone name.

tui.projects_edit.remove_needs_row.note: Footer notice when `x` is pressed with a non-milestone row selected; names the arrow keys.

tui.projects_edit.removed.note: Detail footer after a milestone was removed. {name} is the milestone name.

tui.projects_edit.milestone_added.note: Detail footer after a NEW milestone was added. {name} is the milestone name.

tui.projects_edit.milestone_updated.note: Detail footer when `a` named a milestone that already existed: the store's add-or-update op updated it instead. {name} is the milestone name.

tui.projects_edit.milestone_unchanged.note: Detail footer when `a` echoed an existing milestone exactly: the store reports a truthful no-change. {name} is the milestone name.

tui.projects_edit.prompt_title.note: Appended to the detail title while the add-milestone prompt is up. Keep the leading middot and space, like tui.projects.new_project.

tui.projects_edit.prompt_name_label.note: Label over the prompt's name input. Lowercase, one line.

tui.projects_edit.prompt_name_hint.note: States the store's add-or-update rule so a duplicate name does not surprise. One line.

tui.projects_edit.prompt_name_required.note: Under the name input when it is empty. One line.

tui.projects_edit.prompt_date_label.note: Label over the prompt's optional target-date input. Lowercase.

tui.projects_edit.prompt_date_hint.note: Names the optional format. Keep YYYY-MM-DD literal: it is the accepted spelling.
